name: AgricultureV3
shortDescription: Settings for agricultural-style missions (base for Spray/Spreader)
longDescription: Defines parameters for generating agricultural transects and speed control without camera logic.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: LineSpacing
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Controls spacing between adjacent parallel legs of the pattern.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: GridAngle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Angle of parallel transects relative to North. Adjusts the overall grid orientation.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: EntryLocation
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Determines which corner of the polygon is used to start the mission. Each press of the Rotate Entry button moves clockwise around the polygon: Top Left → Top Right → Bottom Right → Bottom Left → Top Left.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: SpeedMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Select Auto to let the onboard control script manage speed, or Fixed to use a constant user-defined airspeed.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: FixedSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Speed used when Speed Mode is set to Fixed.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TurnAroundDistanceMultiRotor
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Extra distance flown beyond the polygon edge before turning, for multirotor aircraft.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TerrainAdjustTolerance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Allowed altitude error before re-climb when terrain following is enabled.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TerrainAdjustMaxClimbRate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Maximum vertical climb speed for terrain following.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TerrainAdjustMaxDescentRate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDescription: Maximum vertical descent speed for terrain following.
